title: MajorTOM-Global Core
description: MajorTOM Elliot-Pretrain is a unified multi-modal Earth Observation pre-training dataset combining Sentinel-2 L1C, Landsat 8/9 OLI-TIRS, Copernicus DEM GLO-30, and ESA WorldCover into co-registered tiles on a global 10 km grid. It contains 250,000 monotemporal tiles at harmonized resolutions, designed for fast pre-training of multi-modal AI/foundation models. The dataset follows the TACO v3 specification for AI-ready Earth Observation data.

providers.name: Image and Signal Processing Group (ISP), Universitat de València

readme: ## README.md # Major TOM Elliot-Pretrain [![Source Cooperative](https://img.shields.io/badge/Source_Cooperative-majortom--core-blue)](https://source.coop/major-tom/core) [![TACO v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/format-TACO_v3-green)](https://github.com/asterisk-labs/taco/blob/main/spec/main.md) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-CC--BY--SA--4.0-orange)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) MajorTOM Elliot-Pretrain is the first expansion of Major TOM focused on **fast pre-training** of multi-modal AI models on Major TOM data. * It's built on top of the original [MajorTOM](https://github.com/ESA-PhiLab/Major-TOM) global 10 km grid * The files come in 10.56 km footprints with harmonised resolution for faster access * It combines four modalities into a single collection where every tile contains co-registered optical, thermal, elevation, and land cover data This dataset is designed to grow incrementally -- we start with 250,000 monotemporal tiles and are going to add time-series data in the near future. The dataset follows the [TACO v3 specification](https://github.com/asterisk-labs/taco/blob/main/spec/main.md), a format for organizing AI-ready Earth Observation datasets. | Modality | Source | Resolution | Bands | |----------|--------|------------|-------| | Sentinel-2 L1C | ESA Copernicus | 10 m | 13 spectral | | Landsat 8/9 OLI-TIRS | USGS | 30 m | 11 (9 OLI + 2 TIRS) | | Copernicus DEM GLO-30 | ESA / TanDEM-X | 30 m | 1 (elevation) | | ESA WorldCover | ESA | 10 m | 1 (land cover class) | ## Quick Start Pick a tile index and visualize all four modalities: ```python import numpy as np import rasterio import matplotlib.pyplot as plt BASE = "https://data.source.coop/major-tom/core" IDX = 42 # <- change this to explore different tiles MODS = ["s2", "l8", "dem", "wc"] fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(20, 5)) for j, mod in enumerate(MODS): url = f"/vsicurl/{BASE}/DATA/{IDX}/{mod}/data.tif" with rasterio.open(url) as src: if mod in ("s2", "l8"): rgb = src.read([4, 3, 2]).astype(np.float32) axes[j].imshow(np.clip(rgb / 3000, 0, 1).transpose(1, 2, 0)) elif mod == "dem": axes[j].imshow(src.read(1), cmap="terrain") else: axes[j].imshow(src.read(1)) axes[j].set_title(mod) axes[j].axis("off") plt.tight_layout() plt.show() ``` ## Reproducible Example A complete notebook with metadata queries, filtering, and a streaming PyTorch DataLoader with parallel fetching is available here: **[example.ipynb](https://data.source.coop/major-tom/core/example.ipynb)** ## Dataset Structure ``` majortom-core/ |-- COLLECTION.json |-- METADATA/ | |-- collection.parquet | |-- sample.parquet | |-- sample__s2.parquet | |-- sample__l8.parquet | |-- sample__dem.parquet | |-- sample__wc.parquet |-- DATA/ |-- {tile_id}/ |-- s2/data.tif |-- l8/data.tif |-- dem/data.tif |-- wc/data.tif ``` ## Citation ```bibtex @inproceedings{francis2024majortom, title={Major TOM: Expandable Datasets for Earth Observation}, author={Francis, Alistair and Czerkawski, Mikolaj}, booktitle={IGARSS 2024}, pages={2935--2940}, year={2024}, doi={10.1109/IGARSS53475.2024.10640760} } ``` ## License CC-BY-SA-4.0 ## Acknowledgements MajorTOM-Core has been made possible thanks to [Asterisk Labs](https://asterisk.coop), the [ELLIOT](https://elliot-earth.eu) project (European Commission, Horizon Europe, Grant 101214398), and the [Image and Signal Processing Group (ISP)](https://isp.uv.es) at Universitat de Valencia.
